units.source_text: 瓦格纳是国王的朋友，也是一位革命家。

en.t: Wagner was a friend of the king, and also a revolutionary.

units.source_text: 晚年的圣徒瓦格纳，吃饭之前还要进行祈祷呢。

en.t: In his later years, Saint Wagner even prayed before meals.

units.source_text: 无疑，他对生活教的信仰，远远超过了对基督教的信仰。

en.t: Without doubt, his faith in the religion of life far exceeded his faith in Christianity.

units.source_text: 从他遗留下的书简来看，

en.t: Judging from the letters he left behind,

units.source_text: 他在凡间的时候数次被疾苦害的险些让他提前看见死神呢。”

en.t: while he was in this mortal world, illness and suffering nearly made him see death ahead of time on several occasions.
